confidence_notes: Recent Kolkata cost-of-living data supports the meal, coffee, and beer estimates. Cocktail data is sparse; wine is estimated from local beer and bottle prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate.
comparable_city_reasoning: For accommodation, Kolkata is estimated between Hyderabad and Munnar on three-star prices, near Hyderabad on basic rooms, and near the supplied $6–$8 dorm examples. Mumbai is a higher-cost reference.
